claims.claim: The httpx.Timeout class accepts a positional default value that applies to all timeout types unless overridden by keyword arguments.
httpx.ConnectTimeout, httpx.ReadTimeout, httpx.WriteTimeout and httpx.PoolTimeout are all subclasses of httpx.TimeoutException.
The httpx.Limits class configures the maximum number of connections in the connection pool through its max_connections parameter.
claims.citation: which is configured by the `limits` argument

claims.claim: HTTPX always raises a ConnectTimeout exception whenever a request takes longer than the connect timeout to complete.
claims.citation: If HTTPX is unable to connect within this time frame, a `ConnectTimeout` exception is raised.

claims.claim: The pool timeout exists to prevent HTTPX from opening too many connections to a host.
claims.citation: The pool timeout specifies the maximum duration to wait for acquiring a connection from the connection pool.

claims.claim: HTTPX only allows the timeout behavior to be configured separately for connect, read, write and pool timeouts.
claims.citation: You can configure the timeout behavior for any of these values...
